title: People find 'Something to Believe In' at paranormal psychic fair
excerpt: The ‘Something to Believe In’ Paranormal Psychic Fair at the Liberty Metroplex Center is going on this weekend to answer any questions you may have.
content:
LIBERTY, Ohio (WKBN) – Are you a believer in the paranormal and extraterrestrial, or are you more of a skeptic?

The ‘Something to Believe In’ Paranormal Psychic Fair at the Liberty Metroplex Center is going on this weekend to answer any questions you may have.

There’s a little bit of something for everyone–paranormal, mystical, spiritual or the unexplained.

Laura Gramelt, the fair’s coordinator, says you just need to come with an open mind.

“You don’t have to believe in it. I mean if you want to just see what it’s about, keep an open mind,” Gramelt said. “We don’t force it on anybody. If you believe in witchcraft or whatever, nobody forces anything on you. We’re here to answer questions if you want questions answered.”

The fair originally began as a way for Gramelt and her paranormal investigation team to raise funds so they could investigate different locations.

The fair continues Sunday and runs from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. with vendors, classes and free lectures.

Wilson Corbisello contributed to this report.
